page.title: Today's Reading
page.empty: Load or create your birth chart to get a personal reading for today, built from your Moon, running dasha, live transits and today's panchang.
page.whereToday: Where are you today? (sunrise, Rahu Kalam and horas depend on it)
page.staleError: Showing the last reading; refresh failed: {error}
page.tabsLabel: Dasha, transits and houses for today
page.disclaimer: A rule-based reading from classical indicators (Chandra/Tara Bala, gochar with Vedha, panchang, dasha). It describes the day's tone, not fixed events, and is not medical, legal or financial advice.

chart.title: Your chart · today's transits
chart.note: Your natal planets are shown as usual; the purple planets are where the planets are right now. Open Chart Settings to switch style or hide the natal layer.

moon.title: Your Moon today
moon.counted: Counted from your natal Moon it is the {nth} house; from your Lagna it lights up the {lagnaNth} house of {theme}.
moon.overNote: The Moon is crossing the sign of your natal {planets}, so those themes feel closer today.
moon.becomes: It becomes the {nth} from your Moon ({state}). Time is approximate (±15 min).

areas.title: Life areas today
areas.note: Scores combine today's Moon, Tara/Chandra Bala, panchang, and the gochar of the planets that rule each area. They are relative, not absolute.

windows.title: Timing today
windows.noneGood: No clean auspicious window is left today; keep to routine work.

factors.noHelp: No strong supportive factors stand out today.

remedy.title: Anchor for the day
remedy.note: Simple devotional practices only. Gemstones need a full chart review first.

transits.contacts: Transit contacts to your birth chart
transits.noContacts: No close conjunctions or oppositions to your natal planets today.
transits.note: Gochar uses the classical Parashari tables (favourable houses from the natal Moon, with Vedha). Transits colour the day; your dasha and natal promise decide what can actually manifest.

predictions.title: What to expect today
predictions.quiet: No single area stands out strongly today; it is a quiet day astrologically.
predictions.note: Each house is read from your birth chart (Ashtakavarga bindus, Shadbala of its lord, Bhava Bala) against today's transits, drishti and your running dasha. These are tendencies, not fixed events.

dasha.lords: Dasha lords in the sky today
dasha.inSign: In {rashi}: {moonNth} from your Moon, {lagnaNth} from Lagna. {note}
dasha.note: Vimshottari from your birth Moon. The Maha and Antar set the long theme, Pratyantar and Sookshma the weeks, Prana and Deha the hours. A lord that is well placed in your chart and favourable in transit delivers its results more easily.

advanced.stripAria: Hora timeline from {from} to {to}; details are listed below
advanced.legend: green good · amber mixed · red caution · faded = past · outlined = now
advanced.title: Your day, hora by hora
advanced.purpose: Best slot for each purpose, from your own house lords
advanced.horaNote: Hora lords are scored on their strength in your chart (dignity, Shadbala), today's gochar, the choghadiya underneath, and overlap with Rahu Kalam, Yamaganda and Gulika.
advanced.kTitle: Kakshya · fine timing inside the sign
advanced.kMoon: The Moon changes kakshya about every 7 hours. Its bindu windows are the best moments for Moon-ruled matters (mind, people, home).
advanced.recalc: Recalculate this chart to unlock kakshya bindus; sign-level bindus are shown for now.
advanced.kNote: BAV is the planet's own bindu count in the sign it is crossing (4+ is workable, 5+ good). A tick means the kakshya lord of its exact degree also contributed a bindu.
advanced.sNote: Each planet's house is counted from your Lagna, your Moon and your Sun. When all three agree the result is dependable; when they split, the influence is partial.
